parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Radioactive decay is both spontaneous and random.

State what is meant by:

1. spontaneous decay

2. random decay

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.lead:
Strontium-90 (⁹⁰₃₈Sr) is an unstable nuclide.

The activity of a sample of 1.0 × 10⁻⁹ kg of strontium-90 is 5.2 MBq.
parts.text: Determine the decay constant *λ* of strontium-90.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
The activity of the sample after a time of 1.0 half lives is found to be greater than the expected 2.6 MBq.

Suggest a possible reason for this.
